lines.text: Two famous chains just opened in Hong Kong.
lines.zh: 兩大名店啱啱登陸香港

lines.text: Dairy Queen's first shop is in One Causeway Bay.
lines.zh: Dairy Queen首間分店喺銅鑼灣One Causeway Bay

lines.text: Say Upside Down for a large Blizzard at HK$25, until Monday.
lines.say: Say Upside Down for a large Blizzard at twenty-five dollars, until Monday.
lines.zh: 講「反轉唔跌」大杯暴風雪只需HK$25，至星期一

lines.text: Sushi Zanmai from Tokyo is on Humphreys Avenue in Tsim Sha Tsui.
lines.zh: 東京壽司三味喺尖沙咀堪富利士道

lines.text: Dine in, and the first 300 a day get three free tuna sushi.
lines.say: Dine in, and the first three hundred a day get three free tuna sushi.
lines.zh: 堂食每日首300位送三件吞拿魚壽司

lines.text: That's HK$90 of tuna, free until 23 December.
lines.say: That's ninety dollars of tuna, free until December twenty-third.
